userStories.title: M1(e) upgrade cursor reachability — resume at an instance command inserted behind an applied workspace segment
userStories.description: As an operator upgrading an instance already at the 2.39.0 workspace segment to an image carrying the new AddBundledAppSourcePath instance command, I want `upgrade` to run that instance command once without re-running the applied workspace segment, so that the bundled-app column exists and boot stays idempotent.
userStories.completionNotes: Executor done (awaiting orchestrator). UpgradeSequenceRunnerService.resolveStartCursor: workspace last-attempted cursor now resumes at the first unattempted instance command of the instance block preceding the workspace segment (getLastAttemptedInstanceCommand index + 1; whole block when the instance cursor is before it) instead of the segment start. Second defect found while fixing: running such a late instance command wrote workspace-scoped rows that became each workspace's newest cursor, re-queuing the entire applied 2.39.0 workspace segment on the next boot — InstanceCommandRunnerService now skips workspace rows for workspaces whose cursor is already past the step (workspaceIdsPastThisStep). Barrier enforcement accepts cursors past the barrier (also fixes retrying a failed instance step that directly follows a workspace segment, which previously threw). Specs: unit upgrade-sequence-runner-inserted-instance-command.spec.ts (6 cases, mocked services), exclude-workspace-ids.util.spec.ts (3), integration inserted-instance-command.integration-spec.ts (4 cases incl. second-boot no-op). No committed 2-39 file touched, no renumbering. Tier-2 residual: on the dev DB with both workspaces at index 328, `upgrade` runs AddBundledAppSourcePath once (instance row only) and a second `upgrade` is a no-op.

userStories.title: Install log hygiene — refuse an already-installed version before any state change (no ERROR on every boot)
userStories.description: As an operator watching boot logs, I want `install-pre-installed-apps` to report already-installed bundled apps at info level only, so that real install failures are not buried under one ERROR per app per workspace per boot.
userStories.completionNotes: Executor done (awaiting orchestrator). ApplicationInstallService.runInstall: for an INSTALLED application the version-progression check now runs before the UPGRADING state flip and outside the rollback try/catch (new private assertInstallVersionProgressionAllowed). SAME_VERSION → APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED thrown with no log (PreInstalledAppsService/template service keep their info-level skip line); DOWNGRADE/INVALID → one warn line; no UPGRADING→INSTALLED flip-flop, no revertStateToInstalledBestEffort. runInstallWithMetrics no longer counts APP_ALREADY_INSTALLED as app-upgrade/failed. Same exception message/code → failing-application-version-progression integration snapshot unchanged. New unit spec application-install.service.already-installed.spec.ts (3 cases: same version silent refusal, downgrade warn+metric, newer version still UPGRADING→INSTALLED). Tier-2 residual: boot/`install-pre-installed-apps` on a workspace with the bundled apps already installed shows only the PreInstalledAppsService info line.
